name: POWERJACKED - Chalk
programDetails:
🚨 WELCOME TO POWERJACKED — PROGRAM STRUCTURE & WHAT TO EXPECT

PowerJacked is built around the idea that you don’t have to choose between looking good and performing well. This hybrid training system blends speed, power, strength, and aesthetics all into one smartly programmed plan.

🔁 Block-Based Structure (4-Week Blocks)

PowerJacked runs in repeating 4-week training blocks designed to keep your body adapting. Each block introduces a specific stimulus or focus while keeping the overall goal consistent: build strength, power, speed, and a jacked physique. After 4 weeks, the program shifts to fresh challenges so progress never stalls.

📅 What to Expect in Each Block:

- Strategic exercise order that maximizes results
- Athletic components: sprints, plyometrics, and Olympic-type lifts
- Strength foundation: heavy compounds like squats and deadlifts
- Bodybuilding methods for muscle detail and symmetry
- Variations and rep schemes that change weekly to keep stimulus fresh and excitement high

🔥 How Progress Works:

Every 4-week block has built-in progression and variation — that’s the intentional programming that prevents plateaus and keeps results coming. After each block you’ll start a new one that builds on the last, so strength and muscle keep stacking over time.

💡 New Here? Jump Right In! Don’t worry if you’re starting mid-block — you’re not behind. PowerJacked is designed to flow indefinitely with new blocks cycling in regularly. What matters most is consistency, not the calendar date. Training alongside the community and progressing your numbers where you are is what makes the program work.

groups.name: WARMUP
groups.note: Complete 2 times through. Superset all 3 exercises together.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch to Deep Squat
exercises.instruction:
- Set up in squat position, grab toes and perform a good morning, transition into a deep squat focus on pushing your elbows into your knees
- Perform in circuit with other 2 warmup exercises

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridges
exercises.instruction:
- 10 reps each side
- Focus on pushing foot to sky and squeeing glute at top
- Complete with other 2 warmup exercises
Perform Each Side

exercises.name: Pull-Aparts
exercises.instruction:
- Arms straight out in front of you
- Think of squeezing your shoulder blades together 
- Keep tension in the band throughout the movement 
- 20 total reps

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.instruction:
- Week 3: Add (2%) from last week to your top set or about 5-15 pounds
- Take as many feel out sets as you need to get to the top set at 85% of your 1RM
- Set 1: Build up to a top set at 88-90% of your projected 1RM for 3-5 reps going 0-1 RIR
- Set 2&3: Take 7% off the bar and complete 2 more sets of 5-7 reps going 1-2 RIR
Intensity: 8/10

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instruction:
- Any Grip your prefer: just stick with the same grip for the next 4 weeks
- Add weight if able
- Aiming for 3 working sets of 5-7 REPS

exercises.name: Single Arm DB Row
exercises.instruction:
- Can set up any way you prefer: I like having one knee on the bench personally but whatever set up allows you to feel it the best 
- Aiming for 2 working sets of 6-8 reps per side

exercises.name: Straight Arm Lat Pull-Down
exercises.instruction:
- Actively pull with your lats
- Squeeze at the bottom
- Aim for 6-10 reps per set
Intensity: 7.5/10

exercises.name: DB Incline Curl
exercises.instruction:
- Set up bench to a 45-60 degree angle 
- Full lockout at the bottom 
- Complete 3 sets of 8-12 reps
Intensity: 8/10

exercises.name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
exercises.instruction:
- Close grip EZ bar
- 2 working sets of 8-12 reps
Intensity: 8/10

groups.name: Warmup
groups.note: Complete this movement prep 2 times through. Superset all 3 movements together.

exercises.name: Banded TKE
exercises.instruction:
20 reps each leg
- Place thick band behind knee
- Drive up toe
- Squeeze quad and glute while locking out your knee
- Repeat for 20 reps each side

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walks
exercises.instruction:
20 reps each side 
- Place band above knee
- 20 steps to the right then 20 steps to the left
Perform Each Side

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch to Deep Squat
exercises.instruction:
- Start in a good morning position with your knees slightly bent
- Grab your toes
- Stretch hamstrings
- Transition into a deep squat 
- Think of pushing your elbows into your knees and looking up to sky
- Go back into a good morning 
- Repeat for 10 reps
